title: Unstable connection (totally unuseable) V3.1.0.2 Dana i (Samsung S20FE and Xiaomi Poco X3 Pro)
symptom: Pump has intermittent comms causing a variety of catastrophic failures: no treatment buttons, poor BG control, 'Large time difference', 'Application needs BT permission', 'No profile set', 'Pump not initialized, profile not set!', 'Failed to upload basal profile'. The user has been trying to connect for 5 days with poor control.
cause: The thread identifies that on Dana i there are two UTC settings, one in patient access and one in doctor mode, and adjusting the UTC in doctor mode resolved the issues. The cause was incorrect UTC setting on the pump.
fix: Enter doctor mode on the Dana i pump and make sure UTC is correct. Adjusting the UTC setting on the pump resolved the issues.
settings_changed: UTC setting in doctor mode → correct value (not specified)
evidence_quote: Enter doc mode (video on YouTube with Advanced Therapeutics) and make sure UTC is correct
